scope: One actual filesystem recovery failure, no database or performance measurement; original r3 source and expectations remain immutable.

input.journal: Create and seal eighteen original point-register observations through the stable SegmentedJournal; adopt and archive through the frozen candidate APIs.
input.preparedIntent: A separate real process calls prune and exits with os._exit(73) only at its after-manifest callback. Preserve its actual intent, manifest, lock and crash log; do not construct or edit those records.
input.recovery: A new ManagedSource calls recover with the exact plan from the actual prepared intent and explicit exclusive_recovery=True.

soleFault.target: The candidate's actual point.sync_directory call for the managed store after operation.lock is no longer present.
soleFault.injection: Raise OSError at that call exactly once. All earlier calls invoke the real sync_directory function. Do not modify candidate files, source facts, prepared authority, expected outputs, return values, lock checks or marker checks.
soleFault.proofOfPlacement: Record original plan/token/nonce, actual lock absence at injection, finalized manifest generation/pending/completedPlan, intent/marker presence, actual raised exception and source/runtime hashes.

guardDefinition: An existing operation.lock must contain the exact original archive-operation/1 nonce/token, or an operation-failed.json must contain the exact archive-operation-failed/1 nonce/operationToken. A foreign or absent guard does not satisfy this expectation.
resultPolicy: Do not invert the safety expectation to obtain a passing test. If fresh verification completes or the failure loses its guard, write passed:false and exit nonzero while retaining every original input, child log, assertion, exception, source binding and after-state. No cleanup or recovery retry is performed after recording the observed failure.
anticipatedStaticFinding: The original r3 finally block appears to remove the last guard before directory synchronization, outside its preceding except block. This is a hypothesis until actual execution.
